Etymology tree
Central Kurdish کشک ئاو (kişk aw)
Assyrian Neo-Aramaic ܟܲܫܟܵܘܵܐ (kaškāwā)bor.
Arabic كشكاوا
Borrowed from Assyrian Neo-Aramaic ܟܲܫܟܵܘܵܐ (kaškāwā), from Central Kurdish کشک ئاو (kişk aw, literally “water of kashk”).
g: Kashkawa (an Assyrian town in northern Iraq, located in the Nahla valley)
